clauses.title: Timely Reporting Requirement
clauses.rule: All incidents, damages, or losses must be reported to the insurer within 7 days of occurrence.

clauses.title: Theft Claim Documentation
clauses.rule: Total theft claims strictly require a First Information Report (FIR) filed with local police within 24 hours of discovery and submission of both original keys.

clauses.title: Valid Driving License Requirement
clauses.rule: The driver operating the vehicle at the time of the accident must hold an active, valid driving license.

clauses.title: Evidence Consistency
clauses.rule: Incident date, location, and description stated across customer claims, police reports, and repair estimates must match without contradiction.
